result.title: TopoDPO: Dense Preference Alignment for Structure-Sensitive Aerial Referring Segmentation
result.summary: Preference optimization for multimodal segmentation faces a granularity mismatch: dense masks contain spatially heterogeneous preference signals, whereas image-level objectives assign one shared nonlinear weight to all spatial margins. We introduce TopoDPO, a topology-aware dense preference alignment framework for structure-sensitive aerial referring segmentation. Topo-Prior mines informative preference pairs using connected-component discrepancy and macro-corner recall, while the dense objective applies the preference penalty to each local margin before spatial aggregation against a frozen supervised reference. On Topo-RS-Hard, a 4590-instance structural stress set, TopoDPO improves intersection over union (IoU) from 50.91% to 51.24% over image-level direct preference optimization (DPO) and reduces Betti-0 error from 1.34 to 0.90; paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals against image-level DPO exclude zero for all five reported metrics. Matched supervised controls and a complete factorial analysis separate the effects of topology-aware pair mining, localized correction, and dense reference-relative preference weighting. An unfiltered stratification over all 39,244 validation records further shows the clearest structural gains on samples with moderate or severe pre-alignment component-count errors. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/phy709/TopoDPO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TopoDPO，面向结构敏感的航空指代分割，用连通分量差异与大角点召回挖掘偏好对，并把偏好惩罚施加在每个局部 margin 后再空间聚合，以对比冻结的监督参考模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稠密局部偏好 vs 图像级单一权重」的粒度错配分析，可能可供核查 latent 推理中轨迹级与步骤级贡献分配和监督粒度问题，但论文本身不涉及内部 latent 状态或推理期证据获取。
